# ADR-3119: A10: Documented internal fetch exception for admin tool 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some admin workflows need internal URLs.

## Decision

Admin tools MAY adopt a documented internal fetch exception for admin tool 11 (A10-11) when operators need to reach internal health endpoints.

## Consequences

Exceptions are identity-bound and audited.
